instructions: Brown 600g oxtail pieces in 1 tbsp oil in a pot | Add 1 sliced onion 2 cloves garlic 1 stick cinnamon 2 cloves and 1 star anise and fry until fragrant | Pour in 1.5L water 100g carrot chunks 100g potato chunks and 1 stalk chopped celery and bring to boil | Simmer soup for 2 hours until oxtail is tender and broth is rich | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper and serve topped with 1 tbsp fried shallots and chopped celery leaves |

ingredients: mutton ribs spices tomato potato carrot onion milk fried shallot coriander
instructions: Brown 500g mutton ribs in 2 tbsp ghee in deep pot | Add 1 sliced onion 3 cloves garlic 1 inch ginger 1 stick cinnamon 2 star anise and 3 cardamom pods and fry until fragrant | Pour in 1.5L water 1 diced tomato 100g potato cubes and 100g carrot slices and simmer 90 minutes | Add 100ml evaporated milk and simmer 10 minutes more | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper and serve hot topped with 1 tbsp fried shallots and chopped coriander |

ingredients: chicken tomato sauce chili paste onion ginger garlic evaporated milk peas
instructions: Marinate 500g chicken pieces with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp turmeric powder for 20 minutes | Shallow fry chicken in 4 tbsp oil until golden and set aside | In same wok sauté 1 sliced onion 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 inch sliced ginger until fragrant | Add 3 tbsp chili paste and cook 5 minutes then pour in 200ml tomato sauce and 100ml evaporated milk and simmer | Return chicken and 50g peas to sauce and cook 15 minutes until thick then serve with 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: chicken soy sauce sweet soy sauce cinnamon star anise onion garlic ginger chili
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp oil and brown 500g chicken pieces then set aside | In same pot fry 1 sliced onion 3 cloves minced garlic 1 inch sliced ginger 1 stick cinnamon and 2 star anise until fragrant | Add 3 tbsp soy sauce 2 tbsp sweet soy sauce and 200ml water and bring to boil | Return chicken and 2 sliced chilies to pot and simmer 20 minutes until gravy thickens | Serve hot with 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: chicken curry leaves lemongrass garlic ginger coriander powder cumin powder rice flour
instructions: Blend 3 cloves garlic 1 inch ginger 2 stalks lemongrass 1 tsp coriander powder and 1 tsp cumin powder with 3 tbsp water | Marinate 600g chicken pieces with blended paste 1 tsp salt 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbsp rice flour for at least 2 hours | Heat 500ml oil in deep pan and fry a handful of curry leaves until crisp then remove | Deep fry marinated chicken in batches for 10 to 12 minutes until cooked and crispy | Drain chicken and serve topped with fried curry leaves and 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: chicken coconut milk chili paste lemongrass galangal turmeric sugar
instructions: Blend 3 tbsp chili paste 2 stalks lemongrass 1 inch galangal 1 inch ginger and 2 cloves garlic with 100ml water | Marinate 600g chicken with blended paste 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp turmeric powder for 1 hour | Grill chicken over medium charcoal or grill pan while basting with 200ml coconut milk mixed with 1 tbsp sugar | Continue grilling and basting for 25 to 30 minutes until chicken is cooked and slightly charred | Serve with extra 50ml heated coconut gravy and 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: free range chicken coconut milk spice paste turmeric kaffir lime leaf chili
instructions: Blend 5 dried chilies soaked 3 cloves garlic 5 shallots 1 inch ginger and 1 inch turmeric with 50ml water | Fry blended paste in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant and oil separates | Add 700g free range chicken pieces and stir until coated | Pour in 400ml coconut milk 200ml water 3 kaffir lime leaves and simmer 35 minutes until chicken is tender | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar then serve with 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: chicken curry powder coconut milk potatoes lemongrass kaffir lime leaf chili
instructions: Marinate 600g chicken with 2 tbsp curry powder and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes | Sauté 1 sliced onion 3 cloves minced garlic 1 inch ginger 2 stalks lemongrass and 5 dried chilies in 3 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add chicken and 200g potato chunks and stir for 3 minutes | Pour in 300ml coconut milk and 300ml water add 3 kaffir lime leaves and simmer 30 minutes | Adjust seasoning and serve hot with 250g rice |

ingredients: fish fillet chili paste turmeric lime okra tomato onion banana leaf
instructions: Marinate 400g firm fish fillets with 3 tbsp chili paste 1 tsp turmeric powder 1 tbsp lime juice and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes | Toss 80g okra slices 1 sliced tomato and 1 sliced onion with 1 tbsp oil and pinch of salt | Place marinated fish and vegetables on 2 pieces banana leaf and wrap securely | Grill parcels over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes turning once | Serve hot with lime wedges and 200g steamed rice |

ingredients: fish okra tomato tamarind chili paste lemongrass ginger daun kesum
instructions: Blend 3 tbsp chili paste 3 shallots 2 cloves garlic 1 inch ginger and 1 stalk lemongrass with 50ml water | Fry blended paste in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add 500ml water 2 tbsp tamarind paste 2 quartered tomatoes and 80g okra and bring to boil | Add 400g fish pieces and a handful of daun kesum and simmer 10 minutes until fish is cooked | Season with 1 tsp salt and serve hot with 250g rice |

ingredients: fish deep fried chili sauce sweet sour sauce pineapple cucumber onion
instructions: Season 500g whole fish or fillets with 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp corn flour | Deep fry fish in 500ml hot oil until crispy and drain | In another pan sauté 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 sliced onion in 1 tbsp oil | Add 3 tbsp chili sauce 2 tbsp tomato sauce 1 tbsp sugar 1 tbsp vinegar 50g pineapple cubes and 50g cucumber slices with 100ml water and simmer 3 minutes | Pour hot sauce over fried fish and serve immediately |

ingredients: prawn petai chili paste tamarind onion garlic sugar oil
instructions: Peel and devein 400g prawns leaving tails on | Blanch 150g petai in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain | Fry 4 tbsp chili paste 1 sliced onion and 3 cloves minced garlic in 3 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add prawns and petai and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 1 tbsp tamarind paste mixed with 100ml water 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp sugar and cook until gravy thickens then serve with 250g rice |

ingredients: prawn pineapple coconut milk turmeric chili lemongrass
instructions: Blend 5 fresh chilies 3 shallots 1 clove garlic and 1 inch turmeric with 50ml water | Fry blended paste with 1 bruised lemongrass stalk in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant | Pour in 300ml coconut milk and 200ml water and bring to gentle boil | Add 400g prawns and 150g pineapple chunks and cook 5 to 7 minutes until prawns are just cooked | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar and serve with 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: squid flour rice flour egg salt pepper oil
instructions: Clean 400g squid and cut into rings | Mix 50g plain flour 50g rice flour 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper in a bowl | Beat 1 egg and toss squid rings in egg then coat with flour mixture | Heat 500ml oil in deep pan and fry squid in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden | Drain on paper towels and serve hot with chili sauce and lemon wedges |

ingredients: squid chili paste onion tamarind sugar tomato sauce
instructions: Clean 400g squid and cut into rings | Fry 3 tbsp chili paste 1 sliced onion and 2 cloves minced garlic in 3 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add 1 tbsp tamarind paste mixed with 150ml water and 2 tbsp tomato sauce and bring to simmer | Add squid rings and cook 5 to 7 minutes until just tender | Season with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and serve with 250g steamed rice |

ingredients: green mango carrot onion chili dried shrimp lime juice sugar peanuts
instructions: Julienne 200g green mango and 50g carrot into thin strips | Soak 20g dried shrimp in warm water 10 minutes then drain and roughly chop | Slice 1 small onion and 2 red chilies thinly | Mix mango carrot onion chilies and dried shrimp in large bowl | Add 2 tbsp lime juice 1 tbsp sugar 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts and toss well before serving |

ingredients: pineapple cucumber jicama mango rojak sauce peanuts sesame seed
instructions: Cut 100g pineapple 100g cucumber 100g jicama and 100g firm mango into bite size pieces | In a bowl mix 3 tbsp shrimp paste 2 tbsp palm sugar 1 tbsp tamarind paste 1 tbsp chili paste and 2 tbsp water until thick sauce forms | Toss fruit pieces with sauce until well coated | Sprinkle 2 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts and 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds on top | Serve immediately as snack or salad |

ingredients: turnip cucumber fried tofu prawn fritter boiled egg cucumber peanut sauce
instructions: Slice 100g boiled potatoes 100g turnip 100g cucumber and 100g fried tofu into strips | Cut 1 prawn fritter weighing about 80g into pieces and slice 1 hard boiled egg | Arrange vegetables tofu fritter and egg on plate | Pour 150ml thick spicy peanut sweet potato sauce over the mixture | Serve immediately while fritter pieces are still slightly crisp |

ingredients: flour shrimp chives beansprout chili water oil
instructions: Mix 200g flour 1 tsp salt and 250ml water to form thick batter | Stir in 100g small shrimp 30g chopped chives 50g beansprouts and 1 sliced red chili | Heat 500ml oil in deep pan | Drop batter by heaped tablespoon into hot oil and fry 3 to 4 minutes each side until golden | Drain on paper towels and serve hot with 100ml chili sauce |

ingredients: banana flour sugar baking powder water oil sesame seed
instructions: Mash 200g ripe banana in a bowl | Add 100g flour 40g sugar 1 tsp baking powder and 80ml water to form thick batter | Heat 400ml oil in deep pan over medium heat | Drop spoonfuls of batter into oil and fry 3 to 4 minutes until golden and cooked through | Drain on paper towels and serve warm as snack |

ingredients: flour sugar egg milk baking powder crushed peanut sweet corn
instructions: Mix 150g flour 1 tsp baking powder 40g sugar 1 egg and 200ml milk into smooth batter | Heat non stick pan and lightly grease with 1 tsp oil | Pour 1 ladle about 80ml batter and spread into thin circle | Sprinkle 2 tbsp crushed peanuts 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp canned sweet corn over batter | Fold pancake in half when edges crisp then remove and cut into pieces for serving |

ingredients: cendol jelly coconut milk gula melaka shaved ice red bean
instructions: Boil 200ml coconut milk with 1 pandan leaf and 1 tsp salt then chill | Melt 80g gula melaka with 50ml water to form thick syrup and cool | Place 50g cendol jelly and 30g cooked red beans into each serving bowl | Fill bowl with 100g shaved ice | Pour 100ml coconut milk and 2 tbsp gula melaka syrup over ice just before serving |

ingredients: shaved ice red bean sweet corn grass jelly peanuts evaporated milk syrup
instructions: Place 30g cooked red beans 30g sweet corn and 30g diced grass jelly into a bowl | Top with 150g finely shaved ice | Drizzle 2 tbsp colored syrup and 2 tbsp evaporated milk over ice | Sprinkle 1 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts on top | Serve immediately as cold dessert |

ingredients: yam sweet potato tapioca pearl coconut milk sugar pandan
instructions: Boil 50g small tapioca pearls in 500ml water until translucent then drain | Steam 150g yam cubes and 150g sweet potato cubes until just tender | Simmer 400ml coconut milk 300ml water 60g sugar and 1 knotted pandan leaf for 5 minutes | Add yam sweet potato and tapioca pearls to coconut soup and cook 3 minutes | Serve warm or chilled as dessert |

ingredients: glutinous rice coconut milk pandan sugar salt
instructions: Soak 200g glutinous rice for 3 hours then drain | Mix rice with 150ml coconut milk 1 tsp salt and steam in lined tray for 20 minutes then press firmly | Blend 150ml coconut milk 100ml water 60g sugar 50g flour and juice from 10 pandan leaves to make green custard | Pour pandan mixture over pressed rice and steam another 25 minutes on low heat | Cool completely before cutting into squares for serving |

ingredients: flour egg coconut milk pandan grated coconut gula melaka sugar
instructions: Grate 150g coconut and cook with 60g chopped gula melaka 30ml water and 1 pandan leaf until thick then cool | Blend 100g flour 1 egg 200ml coconut milk and juice from 5 pandan leaves into thin batter | Heat small pan lightly greased with 1 tsp oil and pour 40ml batter to make thin crepe | Cook 1 to 2 minutes then flip briefly and remove | Place 1 tbsp coconut filling on crepe roll tightly and serve |

ingredients: flour egg coconut milk sugar pandan oil
instructions: Mix 150g flour 1 egg 250ml coconut milk and juice from 5 pandan leaves into smooth batter | Heat kuih cara mould and brush each cavity with 1 tsp oil | Pour batter to fill three quarters of each cavity | Drop 1 tsp sugar into center of each batter portion | Cover mould and cook 3 to 4 minutes until set then remove kuih and serve warm |

ingredients: rice flour rolls coconut milk fish gravy herbs cucumber bean sprout
instructions: Mix 200g rice flour 50g wheat flour 1 tsp salt and 500ml water to form thin batter | Steam thin layers of batter on oiled plate then roll and slice into noodles | Boil 300g mackerel in 600ml water then flake flesh and blend with 300ml coconut milk and 2 cloves garlic and simmer 5 minutes | Place rice rolls in bowls and top with hot fish coconut gravy | Garnish with 30g sliced cucumber 30g bean sprouts and herbs before serving |

ingredients: rice fish floss chicken rendang egg cucumber banana leaf
instructions: Cook 300g rice until fluffy and cool slightly | Prepare 80g fish floss 100g chicken rendang and 1 thin omelette from 1 egg | Line cone shaped mould or rolled banana leaf with 1 sheet banana leaf | Pack layers of rice fish floss chicken rendang omelette and rice again tightly | Wrap cone and steam 10 minutes to set then serve warm |

ingredients: fish mince sago flour salt sugar oil chili sauce
instructions: Blend 300g fish flesh with 100ml water until smooth | Mix fish paste with 200g sago flour 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar to form dough | Roll dough into long sausages about 2cm thick | Boil rolls in pot of water until they float then drain and cool | Slice into 1cm pieces and deep fry in 500ml oil until golden then serve with 100ml chili sauce |

ingredients: beef skewers lemongrass turmeric coriander sugar peanut sauce ketupat
instructions: Slice 500g beef thinly against grain | Blend 2 stalks lemongrass 3 cloves garlic 5 shallots 1 tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp coriander powder 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp oil into paste | Marinate beef with paste and 1 tsp salt for at least 3 hours | Thread beef onto soaked bamboo skewers | Grill over charcoal for 8 to 10 minutes turning and basting with 2 tbsp oil until slightly charred then serve with 200g peanut sauce and ketupat rice cubes |

ingredients: lamb skewers lemongrass cumin coriander turmeric sugar peanut sauce cucumber onion
instructions: Cut 500g lamb into small cubes | Blend 2 stalks lemongrass 4 shallots 3 cloves garlic 1 tsp cumin powder 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp turmeric powder and 2 tbsp sugar with 3 tbsp water | Marinate lamb with paste and 1 tsp salt for 3 hours | Thread lamb onto bamboo skewers and grill over medium charcoal for 8 to 12 minutes until cooked | Serve skewers with 200g peanut sauce sliced cucumber and onion |

ingredients: fish mince coconut milk chili paste turmeric daun kaduk banana leaf
instructions: Blend 300g fish flesh 100ml coconut milk 3 tbsp chili paste 1 tsp turmeric powder 1 egg 1 tbsp corn flour and 1 tsp salt into thick paste | Mix paste with 30g shredded daun kaduk leaves | Spoon 2 tbsp mixture onto each piece of banana leaf and fold into flat parcel | Grill parcels over charcoal or pan for 8 to 10 minutes turning once until fragrant | Serve warm as snack or side dish |

ingredients: rice chicken mixed vegetables egg soy sauce chili sauce oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok and sauté 3 cloves minced garlic until fragrant | Add 100g diced chicken and cook until no longer pink | Add 250g cold cooked rice 50g mixed vegetables 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp chili sauce and stir fry 3 minutes then set aside | Beat 2 eggs with pinch of salt and make thin omelette in large pan using 1 tsp oil | Place fried rice in center of omelette fold sides over to wrap and serve parcel on plate garnished with cucumber |

ingredients: yellow noodles chicken tofu puff fish ball curry paste coconut milk mint
instructions: Boil 200g yellow noodles and drain | Fry 2 tbsp curry paste in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add 300ml chicken stock and 300ml coconut milk and bring to simmer | Add 100g chicken strips 50g tofu puffs and 50g fish balls and cook 8 minutes | Serve noodles in bowls topped with curry soup and fresh mint leaves and lime wedges |

ingredients: fish paste tofu bitter gourd eggplant okra chili soup sweet sauce chili sauce
instructions: Make fish paste by mixing 300g minced fish with 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp corn flour | Stuff fish paste into 4 tofu puffs 2 bitter gourd rings 4 okra 4 chilies and 4 eggplant pieces | Bring 1L light chicken or anchovy stock to gentle boil | Poach stuffed pieces in stock for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked | Serve pieces in bowl with some soup and 2 tbsp sweet sauce and 2 tbsp chili sauce on side |

ingredients: egg noodles rice vermicelli prawn pork ribs chili paste kangkung fried shallot egg
instructions: Boil 300g pork ribs and 200g prawn shells in 2L water with 2 tbsp chili paste for 2 hours then strain and keep broth | Boil 150g egg noodles and 100g rice vermicelli separately and drain | Blanch 80g peeled prawns and 50g kangkung in boiling broth for 1 minute | Place noodles in bowls top with prawns 1 halved boiled egg and kangkung | Pour hot spicy broth over and garnish with 1 tbsp fried shallots and extra chili paste |

ingredients: rice egg carrot peas chicken garlic soy sauce oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat | Add 2 cloves minced garlic and fry 30 seconds | Add 100g diced chicken and stir fry 3 minutes until cooked | Add 50g diced carrot and 50g peas and cook 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and stir fry 3 minutes | Season with 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp white pepper and mix well | Push rice aside and scramble 2 eggs then combine into rice | Serve hot on a plate |

ingredients: rice anchovies belacan chili garlic onion long bean egg oil
instructions: Fry 50g dried anchovies in 2 tbsp oil until crispy then set aside | In same wok sauté 3 cloves minced garlic 1 sliced onion and 1 tbsp belacan with 2 tbsp chili paste for 2 minutes | Add 50g sliced long beans and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and toss well for 3 minutes | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar and mix | Push rice aside and scramble 1 egg then mix through | Serve topped with crispy anchovies |

ingredients: rice dried anchovies chili onion garlic egg soy sauce oil
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry 60g dried anchovies until golden then remove half for garnish | Add 2 cloves minced garlic 1 sliced onion and 1 tbsp chili paste to remaining anchovies and fry 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and stir fry 3 minutes | Season with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp salt | Push rice aside and scramble 1 egg then mix into rice | Serve hot topped with reserved crispy anchovies |

ingredients: rice chicken mixed vegetables chili paste fish sauce soy sauce garlic oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok and sauté 3 cloves minced garlic until fragrant | Add 150g sliced chicken and fry 3 minutes | Stir in 2 tbsp chili paste 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp soy sauce and cook 1 minute | Add 100g mixed vegetables and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and toss for 3 minutes until evenly coated | Adjust seasoning with 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt if needed | Serve hot with lime wedge |

ingredients: rice beef chicken sausage chili sauce tomato sauce mixed vegetables egg
instructions: Season 100g sliced beef and 100g sliced chicken with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper | Heat 2 tbsp oil and stir fry beef and chicken for 4 minutes | Add 50g sliced sausage and 50g mixed vegetables and cook 2 minutes | Stir in 2 tbsp chili sauce and 2 tbsp tomato sauce | Add 250g cold cooked rice and fry 3 minutes until dry | Fry 1 egg in 1 tbsp oil until sunny side up | Serve rice on plate topped with fried egg |

ingredients: rice tom yam paste prawn squid mushroom long bean lime leaf oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok and add 2 tbsp tom yam paste fry 1 minute | Add 80g peeled prawns and 80g sliced squid and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 50g sliced mushrooms 50g sliced long beans and 3 torn lime leaves and cook 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and toss 3 minutes | Season with 1 tsp fish sauce and 1 tsp sugar | Serve hot with lime wedge |

ingredients: rice beef chili sauce tomato sauce onion capsicum soy sauce oil
instructions: Marinate 150g sliced beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes | Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 1 sliced onion until soft | Add beef and stir fry 3 minutes | Add 50g sliced capsicum 2 tbsp chili sauce and 2 tbsp tomato sauce and cook 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and toss 3 minutes | Adjust seasoning with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar | Serve immediately |

ingredients: rice bird eye chili anchovies garlic onion egg soy sauce oil
instructions: Blend 6 bird eye chilies with 2 cloves garlic and 2 tbsp water | Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry 40g dried anchovies until crispy then set aside | In same wok fry blended chili paste with 1 sliced onion for 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and stir fry 3 minutes | Season with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp salt | Push rice aside and scramble 1 egg then mix through | Top with crispy anchovies before serving |

ingredients: rice ghee evaporated milk cloves cardamom cinnamon raisin cashew fried onion
instructions: Wash 300g basmati rice and drain | Heat 2 tbsp ghee in pot and fry 2 cloves 3 cardamom pods and 1 small cinnamon stick for 1 minute | Add rice and stir 2 minutes until coated | Pour in 400ml water and 100ml evaporated milk with 1 tsp salt | Add 30g raisins and 30g cashews and cook on low heat until rice is fluffy | Top with 2 tbsp fried onions and serve with curry |

ingredients: basmati rice chicken briyani spice yogurt tomato ghee onion raisin cashew
instructions: Marinate 500g chicken with 2 tbsp briyani spice 100g yogurt 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste for 1 hour | Fry 2 sliced onions in 3 tbsp ghee until golden | Add marinated chicken and 2 chopped tomatoes and cook 10 minutes | Half cook 300g basmati rice in boiling water for 7 minutes then drain | Layer rice over chicken and sprinkle 30g raisins and 30g cashews | Add 200ml water cover pot and steam on low for 20 minutes | Fluff rice and serve hot |

ingredients: basmati rice mutton briyani spice yogurt tomato ghee onion raisin cashew
instructions: Marinate 600g mutton pieces with 2 tbsp briyani spice 100g yogurt 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste for 1 hour | Fry 2 sliced onions in 3 tbsp ghee until browned | Add mutton and 2 chopped tomatoes and cook 20 minutes adding 200ml water if needed | Parboil 300g basmati rice for 7 minutes and drain | Layer rice over mutton and sprinkle 30g raisins and 30g cashews | Add 250ml water cover and cook on low 25 minutes | Serve hot with raita |

ingredients: rice tomato paste tomato puree ghee milk cloves cardamom cinnamon fried onion
instructions: Wash 300g rice and drain | Heat 2 tbsp ghee and fry 1 cinnamon stick 3 cloves and 3 cardamom pods 1 minute | Add 2 tbsp tomato paste and 100ml tomato puree and stir 2 minutes | Add rice and coat well | Pour in 450ml water and 50ml milk with 1 tsp salt | Cook on low until rice is fluffy then top with 2 tbsp fried onions | Serve with ayam masak merah |

ingredients: basmati rice ghee evaporated milk food coloring pandan leaf fried onion raisin cashew
instructions: Wash 300g basmati rice and drain | Heat 2 tbsp ghee in pot and fry 1 knotted pandan leaf 2 cloves and 2 cardamom pods 1 minute | Add rice and stir 2 minutes | Pour in 400ml water and 100ml evaporated milk with 1 tsp salt | When almost dry dot surface with 3 different food coloring drops and cover to steam 10 minutes | Fluff rice to mix colors then top with 30g raisins 30g cashews and 2 tbsp fried onions |

ingredients: rice chicken spice flour curry leaves sambal cucumber oil
instructions: Steam 300g rice with 450ml water until fluffy | Blend 3 cloves garlic 5 shallots 1 inch ginger 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp cumin powder and 1 tsp fennel powder with 3 tbsp water | Marinate 600g chicken with blended paste 2 tbsp flour 1 tsp salt and a handful of curry leaves for 2 hours | Deep fry chicken in 600ml oil for 10 to 12 minutes until crispy | Serve steamed rice topped with fried chicken 2 tbsp sambal and sliced cucumber |

ingredients: rice salted fish garlic onion chili egg kailan soy sauce oil
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 40g diced salted fish until fragrant then remove half for garnish | In same wok sauté 2 cloves minced garlic 1 sliced onion and 2 sliced chilies for 1 minute | Add 50g sliced kailan stems and cook 2 minutes | Add 250g cold cooked rice and fried salted fish and stir fry 3 minutes | Season with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar | Push rice aside and scramble 1 egg then mix through | Top with reserved salted fish before serving |

ingredients: rice small fish dried anchovies kangkung garlic chili paste soy sauce oil
instructions: Fry 60g small cleaned fish and 30g dried anchovies in 3 tbsp oil until crispy then set aside | In same wok fry 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp chili paste 1 minute | Add 250g cold cooked rice and stir fry 3 minutes | Add 60g sliced kangkung and cook 2 minutes | Season with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp salt | Serve rice topped with crispy fish and anchovies |

ingredients: yellow noodles chicken prawn cabbage carrot soy sauce oyster sauce thick soy sauce
instructions: Boil 200g yellow noodles 2 minutes then drain | Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 3 cloves minced garlic until fragrant | Add 100g sliced chicken and 50g peeled prawns and stir fry 3 minutes | Add 50g sliced cabbage and 30g carrot strips and cook 2 minutes | Pour in 300ml water 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp thick soy sauce and simmer 3 minutes | Add noodles and toss until sauce thickens slightly | Serve hot with sliced chili |

ingredients: yellow noodles beef soup bone spices celery fried shallot lime
instructions: Boil 400g beef bones and 200g beef slices in 1.5L water with 1 cinnamon stick 3 cloves and 3 cardamom pods for 1.5 hours | Season broth with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper | Boil 200g yellow noodles and drain | Blanch 50g bean sprouts in boiling water 30 seconds | Place noodles and 80g cooked beef in bowls and pour hot broth over | Top with 1 tbsp fried shallots chopped celery leaves and 1 lime wedge |

ingredients: yellow noodles chicken fish ball tofu puff curry paste coconut milk long bean
instructions: Boil 200g yellow noodles and drain | Fry 2 tbsp curry paste in 2 tbsp oil until fragrant | Add 300ml water and 200ml coconut milk and bring to simmer | Add 100g chicken pieces 50g fish balls 50g tofu puffs and 50g cut long beans and cook 8 minutes | Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar | Place noodles in bowls and pour hot curry over then garnish with mint leaves |

ingredients: egg noodles minced beef soy sauce oyster sauce lard oil spring onion fried shallot
instructions: Boil 200g egg noodles until just cooked then rinse and drain | Toss noodles with 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp oyster sauce 1 tsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp lard or cooking oil | Stir fry 100g minced beef with 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp soy sauce for 4 minutes | Place noodles in bowls and top with minced beef | Garnish with 1 tbsp chopped spring onion and 1 tbsp fried shallots |

ingredients: rice vermicelli shredded chicken prawn coconut milk laksa paste bean sprout omelette
instructions: Boil 200g rice vermicelli and drain | Simmer 2 tbsp Sarawak laksa paste with 500ml chicken stock and 200ml coconut milk for 10 minutes | Add 80g peeled prawns and cook 3 minutes then remove prawns | Shred 150g cooked chicken breast | Make a thin omelette with 1 egg and slice into strips | Place vermicelli in bowls and top with chicken prawns 50g bean sprouts and omelette strips | Pour hot laksa soup over and serve with lime and sambal |

ingredients: rice vermicelli egg prawn fish cake cabbage carrot soy sauce dark soy sauce
instructions: Soak 150g rice vermicelli in warm water 10 minutes then drain | Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok and fry 3 cloves minced garlic 30 seconds | Add 80g peeled prawns and 50g sliced fish cake and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 50g shredded cabbage and 30g carrot strips and cook 2 minutes | Add vermicelli 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp dark soy sauce and fry 3 minutes | Push noodles aside and scramble 1 egg then mix in | Serve hot |

ingredients: thick yellow noodles pork belly cabbage lard dark soy sauce garlic pork crackling
instructions: Blanch 200g thick yellow noodles and drain | Heat 2 tbsp lard or oil and fry 3 cloves minced garlic until golden | Add 80g sliced pork belly and stir fry 3 minutes | Add 50g shredded cabbage and 100ml pork stock and bring to simmer | Add noodles 1 tbsp dark soy sauce and 1 tbsp light soy sauce and braise 5 minutes until sauce thickens | Top with 2 tbsp pork crackling and serve hot |

ingredients: flat rice noodles egg prawn fish cake choy sum garlic light soy sauce cornflour
instructions: Blanch 200g flat rice noodles then fry with 1 tbsp soy sauce in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes and set aside | Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 3 cloves minced garlic until fragrant | Add 80g peeled prawns 50g sliced fish cake and 50g cut choy sum and stir fry 2 minutes | Pour in 400ml chicken stock and bring to simmer | Mix 1 tbsp cornflour with 2 tbsp water then stir into stock to thicken | Beat 1 egg and drizzle slowly into gravy while stirring | Pour egg gravy over fried noodles and serve |

ingredients: flat rice noodles chicken prawn choy sum garlic light soy sauce egg cornflour
instructions: Blanch 200g flat rice noodles and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce then set aside | Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 3 cloves minced garlic until fragrant | Add 80g sliced chicken 50g peeled prawns and stir fry 3 minutes | Add 50g cut choy sum and 400ml chicken stock and bring to boil | Mix 1 tbsp cornflour with 2 tbsp water and add to thicken gravy | Beat 1 egg and swirl into gravy | Serve noodles on plate and pour hot gravy over |

ingredients: instant noodles egg tofu potato cabbage chili soy sauce tomato sauce
instructions: Boil 2 packs instant noodles for 2 minutes then drain keeping 50ml cooking water | Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat | Add 1 sliced onion and 2 cloves minced garlic and fry 1 minute | Add 80g diced fried tofu 80g thinly sliced boiled potato and 50g shredded cabbage and stir fry 2 minutes | Add 2 sliced red chilies and continue frying 1 minute | Add noodles and 50ml reserved cooking water and toss well | Season with 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp chili sauce and 1 tbsp tomato sauce and fry 2 to 3 minutes until dry and slightly charred | Push noodles aside and crack 1 egg into wok scramble lightly and mix into noodles | Serve hot with lime wedge and cucumber slices |

ingredients: penne pasta garlic chili flakes tomato basil olive oil parmesan
instructions: Cook 200g penne in salted boiling water until al dente then drain | Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat | Add 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tsp chili flakes and sautÃ© for 1 minute | Pour in 300g crushed tomato and 1 2 tsp salt and simmer for 8 minutes | Toss penne into the sauce and cook 2 minutes | Stir in 10g chopped basil and 20g grated parmesan | Serve hot topped with 10g extra parmesan |

ingredients: ziti pasta ground beef tomato sauce mozzarella ricotta parmesan garlic olive oil
instructions: Cook 200g ziti in salted water until al dente then drain | Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan and sautÃ© 2 cloves minced garlic for 1 minute | Add 200g ground beef 1 2 tsp salt and 1 4 tsp pepper and cook until browned | Stir in 300g tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes | In a bowl mix 120g ricotta with 30g grated parmesan | Combine pasta meat sauce and ricotta mixture in baking dish | Top with 120g shredded mozzarella | Bake at 180Â°C for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly |

ingredients: chicken breast flour butter lemon caper chicken broth olive oil
instructions: Slice 2 chicken breasts about 300g total in half horizontally and pound thin | Season with 1 2 tsp salt and 1 4 tsp pepper then dredge in 40g flour | Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 20g butter in a pan over medium high heat | Cook chicken 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden then set aside | Add 150ml chicken broth juice of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp capers to the pan and simmer 3 minutes | Stir in 20g butter to finish the sauce | Return chicken to pan and coat with sauce for 2 minutes | Serve with 150g cooked pasta or vegetables |

ingredients: spaghetti carrot zucchini bell pepper peas garlic olive oil parmesan
